contact.heroTitle: Send the floor plan. Get a budget range in 48 hours.
contact.heroLead: No call centre and no sales script. A designer reads every enquiry personally and replies within one business day with a budget range, a realistic programme and an honest view of the brief.
contact.contactText: The more of this you can fill in, the more useful our first reply will be. Floor plans and photographs help most.
contact.contactAsideText: Three things, in this order, within one business day.

contactAside.v: A designer reads the enquiry and the floor plan.
We reply with a budget range and a realistic programme.
If it looks right, we book a free 60-minute consultation.

contact.contactNote: We reply to every enquiry, including the ones we cannot help with. If we are not the right studio for your project we will say so and suggest who is.
contact.locText: Lahore is the design studio and workshop. Islamabad and Karachi are project offices that support delivery and our specifier network.
contact.splitText: Ten minutes of preparation on your side saves a fortnight on ours. These are the five things that let a designer give you a real number rather than a range so wide it means nothing.
contact.splitText2: You do not need all five. Send what you have — an annotated floor plan and a target date is usually enough for a first reply.
contact.splitImageAlt: Material samples arranged on a studio table

splitListItems.v: Dimensions in feet and metres, with door and window positions if you have them.
When the space must be usable — a launch, a lease start, a wedding, a term.
Even a rough band helps. We will tell you honestly if the brief and the budget do not meet.
Existing conditions, ceiling height, services, access routes and anything that cannot be moved.
Who signs off the design, and who signs off the spend — if they are different people.

contact.splitQuote: Send the floor plan. We will send a budget range within forty-eight hours.
contact.faqText: How projects begin, what we need from you, and how quickly we reply.
contact.ctaText: Sixty minutes at the Gulberg studio, on your site, or on video. Free, no obligation, and you leave with a budget range.

contact-two.heroLead: Direct lines, email addresses and office hours for the studio, projects and workshop teams.
contact-two.contactText: A designer reads every enquiry personally and replies within one business day.
contact-two.contactAsideText: Prefer to speak to someone? These lines are answered during studio hours.

contact-three.heroLead: The fastest way to understand how we work is an hour in Sundar Industrial Estate: machines running, panels numbered, a dry-assembly you can touch. Visits are by appointment.
contact-three.locText: Pick the location closest to your project. Each office has its own direct line and opening hours.
contact-three.contactText: Tell us which you would like to see, and a date that suits. Studio visits are an hour; workshop visits run about ninety minutes including a dry-assembly walkthrough.

thank-you.heroLead: We reply to every enquiry within one business day — usually sooner. If your project has a hard deadline, call the studio line and quote your reference so we can prioritise it.
